services.heading: GCSE and A level maths and science tutoring, in Ilkley or online.

about.statement: We started Hillside Tutors to give students steady, personal support through GCSE and A level science and maths.

items.question: Do you tutor in person or online?
items.answer: Both. You can learn with us in person in Ilkley or join sessions online, whichever suits you.

items.question: What subjects do you cover?
items.answer: We tutor maths and science, for students working towards GCSE or A level exams.

items.question: Will I have the same tutor each week?
items.answer: Yes. You keep the same tutor every week, so you can build steady progress together.

items.question: Can I choose one to one tutoring?
items.answer: Yes. Alongside small group classes, we offer one to one sessions if you prefer individual support.

items.question: How big are the group sessions?
items.answer: Groups are four students at most, so you still get proper attention and time to ask questions.
